Nova X300 revenue declined 20.8% quarter over quarter, primarily alongside a 16.7% reduction in units; realised price fell 4.9%. Stock availability does not currently appear to be the leading explanation: current-quarter availability averaged 94.6% with five stockout days and was described as comparatively stable. Meanwhile, return rate rose from 1.77% to 4.47%, including 133 quality-coded returns, while availability remained relatively stable at 94.6% with five stockout days. Nova X300 revenue fell 20.8% quarter over quarter in Q4 2025, primarily alongside a 16.7% decline in units; realised price declined 4.9%. During the same quarter, average returns rose from 1.77% to 4.47%, including 133 quality-coded returns. Customer feedback reports recurring audio dropouts and a loose or clicking hinge. Together, these observations make product quality the strongest supported explanation for weaker unit performance, but they show association—not that quality issues caused the sales decline. Availability, averaging 94.6% with five stockout days, is not the leading hypothesis.
